title: EventRecord
description: Schema definition for shared operating system event records across all manager modules.

timestamp.description: Simulation time clock tick or timestamp when the event occurred.

manager.description: The operating system manager that emitted the event.

event_type.description: The category or class of event (e.g., SCHEDULING, PAGE_FAULT, FILE_IO, AUTHENTICATION).

entity_id.description: Identifier for the target process, thread, frame, node, file, or packet.

action.description: Operation or step executed by the manager.

previous_state.description: State of the entity prior to this event.

new_state.description: State of the entity after this event.

duration_or_cost.description: Simulated latency, execution duration, or overhead cost associated with the event.

explanatory_message.description: Human-readable detail message for audit logs and UI logs.

correlation_id.description: ID used to correlate cross-manager event chains across integrated scenarios.
